caption: The drawing depicts three separate jewelry items, each laid out horizontally against a plain, light beige background. At the top, there is a bracelet composed of eight circular floral-like elements, where the center piece is the largest, and they are all encrusted with red gemstones. The settings connecting the pieces are colored in gold tones, and a chain clasp is visible at the right end, attached to a scalloped white backing. Below the first bracelet is its reverse side, showing the backs of the same eight circular sections in gold-brown, with a visible clasp at the far right and the same graduated sizing from the center outward. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a geometrically arranged bracelet forming an open octagonal or star-like shape, each point or vertex highlighted by a triangular cluster of red gemstones set in a gold structure. The composition is orderly, with each item displayed separately with space between, and the artist’s name “John. H. Tercuzzi.” is written in small letters at the lower left corner.
title: Bracelet
